svg.title: Valour Missile Corvette - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Adventure Class Ships (2023), printed 106-107, PDF 107-108. Middle-deck central envelope aligned with upper/lower decks. Paired aft fuel pods positioned from detached deck rectangles and illustration, with approximate short connections and rounded forward caps. Four vertically stacked pods project as two in top view. Interpreted placement; no detached turret diagrams.
